name: Look Before You Leap: Context-Sensitive GUI Grounding for Boosting Automated Extended Reality (XR) Testing
notes: The benchmark contains 1,552 images from 100 industrial-setting Steam apps, with 4,470 interactable annotations across 766 semantic categories. The authors report higher F1 scores than comparison detectors and more element coverage and effective interactions in guided testing.
summary: Orienter detects interactive elements in 3D XR interfaces using app context and iterative reflection, then evaluates detection and guided testing on Steam app images.
